resources.string: Personal assistant for accessibility and automation. Reads screen content to help control your phone hands-free for people with mobility or visual impairments.
Needed to send and read SMS messages for auto-reply and messaging commands.
Needed to make phone calls and read call logs for missed call automation.
Needed to access contacts for messaging and calling by name.
Needed for voice commands and speech recognition.
Needed for potential future features (QR scanning, etc.).
Needed to show assistant responses and status.
Needed to read calendar events for scheduling.
Needed to read media files and control playback.
Enable in Settings → Accessibility → Agentic OS Assistant. Allows the assistant to read your screen and help with automation for accessibility purposes.
Enable in Settings → Notifications → Notification Access → Agentic OS. Allows reading notifications for automation.
Enable in Settings → Digital Wellbeing → Usage Access → Agentic OS. Helps with smart automations.
Enable in Settings → Apps → Special Access → Display over other apps → Agentic OS. Shows the floating assistant button.
Your personal phone assistant for accessibility and automation. Helps control your phone hands-free.
Send texts, make calls, read messages, and auto-reply to missed calls.
Automate actions when you arrive at work, leave home, or enter geofences.
Play music, backup photos automatically, and control media playback.
Set alarms, toggle WiFi/Bluetooth, get notifications, and use voice commands.
Required for screen reading, auto-reply, and notification monitoring for accessibility assistance.
